title: HEALING IN
HIS PRESENCE
end: The Healing Balm — receive God's healing peace
stock_queries: tranquil turquoise living waters flowing softly in sunlight
warm golden sanctuary light filtering through quiet pillars
white dove peaceful flight over calm waters at sunrise
gentle morning dew on green leaves in soft focus
serene mountain stream under a peaceful blue sky
soft golden hour rays resting on an empty wooden bench
tranquil ripples on a clear lake reflecting soft clouds

scenes.a: Right in the middle of your quietest midnight worry, hear this.
The psalmist declared, O Lord my God, I cried unto thee, and thou hast healed me.
Lord, when my body is tired and my spirit feels fragile, you know the exact depth of my need.
Grant me the grace to release every racing thought into the safety of your healing hands.
Fill this weary heart with your gentle restoration, calming the storms that rise within me.
May your presence be my shelter tonight, offering deep peace as I rest in your love.
